author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** (1) New polaris-backend/src/ingest/aggregator.rs: ReportAggregator::run() loops every 5s, claims SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED a batch of reports with incident_id IS NULL, groups by subject_id, attaches to existing open incident within 24h window or creates new. (2) Migration 23: ALTER TABLE incidents ADD COLUMN report_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; trigger on reports INSERT/UPDATE-of-incident_id increments parent. (3) Routing pre-existing for CSAM-priority via routing/mod.rs — assert the test that the priority survives under load. Un-ignore T4 CSAM-priority sub-assertion.
